title: SIH26171 Client-Server Action Contract
description: DRAFT by Aparna, single-shot design (no sessions). Danwin to review/finalize on return.

task_description.description: What the user wants done, e.g. 'Fill in the bio and favorite color fields, then submit.'

dom_summary.description: Sanitized structural DOM info - no raw PII values, just structure/labels/selectors

redacted_image_b64.description: Base64 PNG, POST-redaction screenshot only. Faces blurred, PII black-boxed.

Action.description: Single next action, returned by server, executed by extension

target.description: CSS selector or short element description

value.description: Text to type, only used when type='type'

reasoning.description: One sentence on why this action was chosen

notes: Design decision: single-shot, not session-based. Extension loops: capture -> redact -> POST /analyze -> execute action -> repeat, until action.type == 'done'.
No session ID, no server-side state between calls - server is stateless, re-reasons from scratch each call using fresh dom_summary + redacted_image_b64.
Rationale: simpler under hackathon deadline, no session storage/cleanup bugs, Gemini doesn't need conversation memory if each call gets full current context.

OPEN QUESTION FOR DANWIN: does executor.js need target to be a guaranteed-valid CSS selector, or should it support fallback matching (e.g. text content) in case Gemini's selector guess is wrong/stale?
OPEN QUESTION FOR DANWIN: does scroll need a direction/amount field? Currently has nowhere to put that.
